18:98.text: said: "This is a mercy from my Lord, but when the Promise of my Lord comes, He shall level it down to the ground. And the Promise of my Lord is ever true."

18:99.text: [i.e. the Day Ya’jûj and Ma’jûj (Gog and Magog) will come out]
, We shall leave them to surge like waves on one another; and the Trumpet will be blown, and We shall collect them

18:100.text: And on that Day We shall present Hell to the disbelievers, plain to view -

18:101.text: those whose eyes had been under a covering from My Reminder
, and who could not bear to hear

18:102.text: Do then those who disbelieved think that they can take My slaves
[i.e., the angels, Allâh’s Messengers, ‘Îsâ (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary)]
besides Me? Verily, We have prepared Hell as an entertainment for the disbelievers
(in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)

18:103.text: : "Shall We tell you the greatest losers in respect of

18:104.text: "Those whose efforts have been wasted in this life while they thought that they were acquiring good by their deeds.

18:105.text: "They are those who deny the Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
of their Lord and the Meeting with Him
. So their works are in vain, and on the Day of Resurrection, We shall assign no weight for them.

18:106.text: "That shall be their recompense, Hell; because they disbelieved and took My Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
and My Messengers by way of jest and mockery.

18:107.text: (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism)
and do righteous deeds, shall have the Gardens of Al-Firdaus

18:108.text: . No desire will they have for removal therefrom."
